Computer Science (bachelor's programme)

Delve into the world of technology and innovation: in the bachelor's programme in Computer Science, you will solve complex problems and develop software that actively shapes the digital future. This degree programme will teach you the foundations of Computer Science and prepare you for the challenges of the digital world.

    Please note: the entrance exam procedure takes place only once per academic year! Only those who successfully participate in it and meet all admission requirements can start their studies. 

What is it about?

Do you want to not only use developments in Computer Science, but also understand them and contribute to them yourself? In the bachelor's programme in Computer Science, you will work in an practical and interdisciplinary manner. You will deal with topics such as programming, algorithms, databases and artificial intelligence.

Is one topic of particular interest to you? Then you can specialise in your favourite area, such as Data Science, Media Informatics, Medical Informatics or Scientific Computing. This opens up a wide range of prospects in a dynamic and future-oriented professional field.

What can you expect after your studies?

Continue studying or start your career straight away? After completing your bachelor's programme, all paths are open to you. Whether you decide to pursue a master's degree or take the plunge into the world of work, the possibilities are endless. The following overview shows you what options you have and where you can find the right support:

Your perspectives

  • Master's programmes

    After completing your bachelor's programme, you can begin a relevant master's programme at the University of Vienna. Take a look at the Master Access Guide to find a fitting option.

    • Master Access Guide

    Did you know? In certain cases completing extension curricula (EC) during your bachelor's programme can open up access to master's programmes in a different subject field.

    • Extension curricula (EC) (website only available in German)

  • Your entry into working life

    When starting your career, many questions arise. Uniport – the career service of the University of Vienna – supports you with individual advice, webinars and workshops. Gain insights into different career profiles at career events and connect with potential employers.

    • Uniport – the career service of the University of Vienna (website only available in German)

Career profiles

  • Which careers are possible after this degree?

    After graduating from this programme, you will have career opportunities in virtually all sectors and in many areas, including:

    • Software development and software architecture
    • Data management and analysis
    • Artificial intelligence and machine learning
    • Systems and infrastructure
